chapter: Cab Calloway's band, Hadacol and closing reflections
title: The Senator's suite, five hundred dollars and the watch that never came
summary: At the Senator's hotel suite, half-naked women and cronies surrounded him as he gave Danny five hundred dollars and promised Lu a watch.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: So I got this plan. So I go there and he said, 'Come on upstairs.' So we go up the elevator. A guy came down to get me. We go up the elevator and he's on the third floor. And he's got about six of his cronies there, and these chicks, half-naked chicks running all over the place. They had grabbed a whole wing of the hotel. And he said, 'Oh, thank you for coming. I'm so glad to see you, and I appreciate you being here.' He said, 'Have a seat. Won't you have a drink?' And the other cats with him, these country people with them big white hats on, and... I said, 'Yes.' I was drinking then. So I got me a big (?) of bourbon.

And he said, 'I'm going to show you why my heart is in the right place.' And he went in his pocket and he got a hundred dollar bill. He gave me five hundred dollars. He said, 'Now, thank you.' He said, 'Now, for your wife, since she's not, here, tell her I'm going to send her a ring...'
He was going to send me a watch, not a ring.
A watch. Yeah, 'I'm going to send her a watch.' She never did get the watch.' Okay. So I said 'All right.'
